messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@catalyst.health>, Procurement <procurement@catalyst.health>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal kickoff: term bridge, capacity stitch & QBR scheduling

Hi Elena (+ Catalyst procurement team),

Thanks for the heads-up about the upcoming renewal window. I’m Monica (Customer Success lead for Catalyst Health) — looping in Karthik (AM) and Priyom (Sales Eng) to kick off the renewal + uplift planning. We want to align on a short path to extend the term, stitch the burst capacity you’ve been using into the next contract year, and lock a QBR to review the plan and exec approvals.

High-level proposed timeline:
- Week of 5/25: QBR to review MA plan, capacity needs, and term amendment
- Week of 6/1: Finalize commercial terms & procurement checklist
- Mid-June: DocuSign + start of revised term

Asks for you (quick):
1) Confirm who from Catalyst needs to attend the QBR (exec + procurement + engineering).
2) Are you available for a 60-minute QBR sometime the week of 5/25? Our suggested windows: Tue 5/26 10–11am PT or Wed 5/27 1–2pm PT.
3) Any special procurement items (PO cadence, required SLAs, security checklist) we should pre-populate?

Attached: a working Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a draft QBR agenda. We’ll bring a short readout on current usage headroom and a pricing amendment that maps burst capacity into a staircase/step plan.

If those QBR slots don’t work, tell us a couple of alternatives and we’ll adapt. Priyom — can you prep a quick throughput/latency slide for the QBR? Karthik — flag any legal/finance constraints you want me to surface ahead of time.

Thanks — looking forward to locking dates.

Best,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: term bridge, capacity stitch & QBR scheduling

Thanks Monica — appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers below:

1) Attendees: Myself (Head of AI Ops), Samir Rao (Engineering lead), and our procurement contact (procurement@catalyst.health). I’ll confirm if an exec will join but likely either our CTO (TBD) or VP of Product.
2) QBR preference: Tue 5/26 10–11am PT works best for the team. Please tentatively hold that slot.
3) Procurement items: Please include an SLA addendum we can evaluate (uptime and incident response), and we’ll need pricing in a staircase format with clear burst/overage rules.

I attached our internal procurement intake form for your finance/legal folks — will help speed the contract path. If you can send an updated MAP with the staircase pricing and a short note on the SLA addendum before the QBR, that will make the meeting productive.

Hi all — thanks for the quick responses.

We’re locked for the QBR: Tue, 26 May 2026, 10:00–11:00am PT (Zoom link to follow). Draft agenda (60m):
- 5m intros & objectives
- 10m usage readout & headroom (Priyom)
- 15m MAP & staircase pricing (Karthik)
- 15m SLA addendum highlights & procurement checklist (Monica / Legal)
- 10m decisions & next steps (DocuSign handoff cadence)

Action items before the QBR:
- Redwood: update MAP with staircase pricing + attach SLA addendum (Karthik / Monica) — due Mon 5/25 EOD
- Catalyst: confirm exec attendee and upload PO/process notes to the intake form — Elena / Procurement
- Priyom: 1-slide throughput vs. proposed tiers — due Mon 5/25 EOD

I’ll also start a DocuSign envelope with the pricing amendment once we have the MAP updates; will share the link in the meeting so procurement can triage.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning next week.
